name: 11501 · Mineola, NY
findings: ZIP 11501 (Mineola) has 153 nonprofit organizations. 66 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 60 organizations.
Professional organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11501 (Mineola) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
26% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 11501 (Mineola) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 60 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
